description: This file provides platform-dependent utility functions for the Atom Table Object, including the creation function 'AnscCreateAtomTable' which internally calls 'AnscAtoCreate'. It contains licensing information, module description, and the implementation of a factory function for the Atom Table object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscCreateAtomTable(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates a new Atom Table Object by calling internal creator 'AnscAtoCreate' with provided context handles.
